card.name: Digits before a thousands comma
card.fires_on: A digit inside a number written with comma separators, just before the comma and a group of three zeros or digits. Typical examples are 200,000, 23,000 and 7,216,040.

modes.label: Last digit before comma
modes.description: The final digit before a comma in a large number such as a count or dose.

modes.label: Digit in population or money
modes.description: A digit within a multi-group number such as a population or dollar amount.
